final_message:
I fixed it, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen printed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit. I added a small set of zero-decimal currencies (just `JPY` for now) that skips the division and decimals, so 500 now prints as `¥500`.

`formatMoney` is also used by cart totals and invoice lines, so yen amounts there now display correctly too. Nothing else in the repo uses yen, and the other tests are unaffected.
